shelters.name: Animal Rescue League of Iowa
shelters.description: Iowa's largest nonprofit animal shelter since 1926, helping more than 1 million pets. Ranked in top ten for Most Influential Nonprofit by Business Record. Programs include adoption, education, training, spay/neuter, and cruelty intervention.

shelters.name: Furry Friends Refuge
shelters.description: Assists all area animals in need through adoptions, spay/neuter, community outreach, and humane education. Partners with WestPet Animal Control for West Des Moines, Clive, and Urbandale.

shelters.name: Cedar Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit helping over 2,000 animals every year find their forever homes.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Scott County
shelters.description: Nonprofit open admission animal shelter serving Scott County including Davenport, Bettendorf, and Quad Cities area. Open daily 8am-5pm including weekends.

shelters.name: Siouxland Humane Society
shelters.description: Siouxland's only open admission full service shelter, caring for thousands of pets each year. Finds forever homes for 100% of adoptable pets.

shelters.name: Noah's Hope Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Rescues, rehabilitates, and finds loving homes for abandoned and neglected animals in the Sioux City area.

shelters.name: Iowa City Animal Services
shelters.description: Open for walk-in business including licensing, animal permits, and dog park passes. Provides animal adoption services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northwest Iowa
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal shelter serving Dickinson, Clay, Emmet, Palo Alto, O'Brien and Osceola counties. Promotes ethical and humane treatment of all animals.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northeast Iowa
shelters.description: Humane society serving Northeast Iowa with animal welfare services and adoption programs.

shelters.name: Midlands Humane Society
shelters.description: First humane society in Council Bluffs, opened 2015. Comprehensive animal welfare center with 200+ animals in care daily. Supports Pottawattamie County.

shelters.name: Dubuque Regional Humane Society
shelters.description: Protects and promotes animal well-being by fostering respect for their dignity. Offers lost & found, Hadley's Dog Park, Vets Need Pets program.

shelters.name: S.A.I.N.T. Cat Rescue & Adoption
shelters.description: No-Kill Verified cat rescue organization serving the Cedar Rapids area.

shelters.name: Gems Forever Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization founded in 2016 serving the Cedar Rapids area.

shelters.name: Pottawattamie County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County animal shelter. Adoption fee $120 includes spay/neuter, microchip, all vaccinations, deworming, and heartworm test.

shelters.name: It Takes A Village Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Des Moines metro area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: AHeinz57 Pet Rescue & Transport
shelters.description: Nonprofit pet rescue and transport organization serving central Iowa.

shelters.name: Black Hawk Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Waterloo and Cedar Falls area with animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Story County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Story County animal shelter serving the Ames area with animal control and adoption services.

shelters.name: Raccoon Valley Animal Sanctuary & Rescue
shelters.description: Animal sanctuary and rescue serving the Des Moines metro area.

shelters.name: Linn County Animal Services
shelters.description: Linn County animal services providing animal control and shelter services for Cedar Rapids and surrounding area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Iowa animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Animal Rescue League of Iowa (since 1926) is the state's largest nonprofit, helping over 1 million pets. Coverage spans Des Moines, Cedar Rapids, Davenport/Quad Cities, Sioux City, Iowa City, Council Bluffs, Dubuque, Waterloo, Ames, and Spencer.
